rows.label: bf06420100_0010
rows.name:
Meleph-sama, you're
making that face again.

rows.label: bf06420100_0020
rows.name:
If you keep frowning like
that, you'll get wrinkles.

rows.label: bf06420100_0030
rows.name: ...I just don't get it.

rows.label: bf06420100_0040
rows.name: The anti-Adel faction founded Luxuria...

rows.label: bf06420100_0050
rows.name:
After the war, they completely avoided
interference from other countries.

rows.label: bf06420100_0060
rows.name:
But...the way the king was acting... I can't
help feeling there's something more to it.

rows.label: bf06420100_0070
rows.name: What, though?

rows.label: bf06420100_0080
rows.name: This whole matter was at the Holy See's request.

rows.label: bf06420100_0090
rows.name: His reason for rejecting it so strongly...

rows.label: bf06420100_0100
rows.name:
It seemed almost like he wanted
to cut ties with them...

rows.label: bf06420100_0110
rows.name:
Does that mean the Holy See has
some other hold over them?

rows.label: bf06420100_0120
rows.name:
That would explain it. Zeke, do
you know anything about that?

rows.label: bf06420100_0130
rows.name: Don't know, there are no records left.

rows.label: bf06420100_0140
rows.name: How about you?

rows.label: bf06420100_0150
rows.name:
There's nothing in my
diary from that time.

rows.label: bf06420100_0160
rows.name:
I might have been returned to my
core for some reason or other.

rows.label: bf06420100_0170
rows.name:
Do you know anything about
those days, Gramps?

rows.label: bf06420100_0180
rows.name: Mmm? I-I was somewhere else at the time.

rows.label: bf06420100_0190
rows.name:
And matters of human kingdoms and
so on didn't interest me much.

rows.label: bf06420100_0200
rows.name:
What? For someone who's gotten so old,
you're not much use.

rows.label: bf06420100_0210
rows.name: You sound just like Correl.

rows.label: bf06420100_0220
rows.name:
So you think the king wasn't
telling us everything?

rows.label: bf06420100_0230
rows.name: There is a chance.

rows.label: bf06420100_0240
rows.name:
Could that be related to Shin and the others
inheriting Iira's name?

rows.label: bf06430100_0010
rows.name:
"If you see the world that lies ahead, you will
understand. You have come this far..."
